senses.gloss:
Ābayu is apparently the name of a plant in the Atharvaveda; the mustard plant may have been meant, but the sense is quite uncertain.
Foot notes vi. 16, 1.
Bloomfield, Hymns of the Atharvaveda, 465, following the indication of the use of the hymn in the kauśika sūtra.
Whitney, Translation of the Atharvaveda, 292; Zimmer. Altindisches Leben, 72.
